page_title: MON 1-0 REN | Monaco v Rennes 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Stephanie Frappart is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+6' Desire Doue (Rennes) sends a lofted pass from the resulting free kick, but fails to hit the ball properly and his effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
90+5' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) jumps into a tackle and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul. Rennes earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+4' The corner kick from Desire Doue (Rennes) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+1' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Monaco will take a free kick.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Here is a change. Maghnes Akliouche is going off and Adi Hutter gives the last tactical orders to Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
86' Stephanie Frappart has a clear sight and sees a foul from Vanderson (Monaco). Rennes earn a free kick.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) will replace Arnaud Kalimuendo.
82' It looks like Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) saw red with that tackle. Stephanie Frappart won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
81' Arthur Theate (Rennes) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
80' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Rennes players are visibly unhappy with the call.

79' Play continues despite the shouts by some Rennes players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Stephanie Frappart interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
79' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Rennes for a penalty. Play continues.
78' Vanderson (Monaco) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
77' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
75' A snap shot by Ludovic Blas (Rennes) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Radoslaw Majecki produces a good save to thwart him.
75' That's the end of the game for Amine Gouiri, who is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
74' Rennes fail to score from a corner as Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco) leaps to collect the ball.
74' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Rennes win a corner kick.
73' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Wissam Ben Yedder will be replaced by Folarin Balogun (Monaco).
71' Stephanie Frappart couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) and blew his whistle. Monaco are awarded the free kick.
70' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
68' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) is substituted due to injury. Adi Hutter gives a chance to Kassoum Ouattara.
66' Julien Stephan prepares a substitution. Alidu Seidu (Rennes) is replaced by Guela Doue.
66' Julien Stephan has decided to make a change. Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) replaces Benjamin Bourigeaud.
66' It's time for a substitution. Baptiste Santamaria comes on in place of Azor Matusiwa (Rennes).
66' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
64' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle and Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
61' Monaco will take a corner kick.

61' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top right corner, but Steve Mandanda thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
57' Flag goes up against Adrien Truffert (Rennes) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
55' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
55' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
54' Desire Doue (Rennes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
54' Desire Doue (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
53' Monaco take a short corner kick.

53' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

51' Vanderson (Monaco) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stephanie Frappart no option but to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Rennes, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
48' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Steve Mandanda.
48' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
47' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Martin Terrier (Rennes) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
46' Referee Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

45+2' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Monaco.
45+1' The current number of shots on goal is 3:6. The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:8.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

44' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
43' Vanderson (Monaco) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick has been awarded to Rennes.
42' Vanderson (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but Steve Mandanda comes off his line to gather the ball.
39' Arthur Theate (Rennes) brings an opponent down and Stephanie Frappart interrupts the game. A free kick to Monaco.
39' A superb shot by Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
37' Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul after Vanderson (Monaco) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Rennes are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
36' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

33' Steve Mandanda doesn't have to worry about this one. Youssouf Fofana plays a pass into the feet of Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
31' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
30' A player from Monaco commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Free kick. Rennes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
29' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) commits a rough foul. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and makes a call. Monaco win a free kick.
29' A first-time shot by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
28' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
26' A player from Rennes commits a rough challenge. Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Monaco get a free kick.
25' 1 - 0 Goal Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco)! Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) was put through by Ismail Jakobs and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
23' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' The game is interrupted now, Alidu Seidu (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
21' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Radoslaw Majecki. What a save!
21' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Radoslaw Majecki stops the ball from going inside right post.
19' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

18' Martin Terrier (Rennes) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and tries a snap shot towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and brushes the post. That was a fantastic reflex save. Rennes force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
15' What a wasted opportunity by Amine Gouiri (Rennes)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Radoslaw Majecki makes a decent save to thwart him.

12' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Steve Mandanda dived superbly to block a header by Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Steve Mandanda pulled off a remarkable save!
12' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

11' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Steve Mandanda sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post. Monaco force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
7' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul. Monaco have been awarded a free kick.

5' That didn't go as planned! Adrien Truffert (Rennes) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Radoslaw Majecki, who easily kept it out.

4' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
3' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stephanie Frappart signals. It's a free kick to Monaco in a dangerous position.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Stephanie Frappart will referee today's match.
